digest.component_or_area: test suite — Jira DC transport and pagination guards
propositions: Five confirmed tests have assertions that cannot fail or are tautologies: PAT repr test never receives a PAT, pagination guard teeth re-implements AST walk instead of calling the shared predicate, validate_assignee_exists test checks existence not return value, rate-limit sweep uses <= instead of ==, unknown-backend test only pins a class relationship not raising behaviour
The PAT-repr test must construct a transport that actually carries a credential and assert it does not leak into repr()

The pagination helper _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() must accept an optional source parameter so the teeth test can feed it synthetic unpaginated code instead of re-implementing the AST walk inline
The validate_assignee_exists test must call the method and assert it returns a username string for DC and accountId for Cloud, not merely verify it exists
The rate-limit sweep must assert total == 1 (not <=) per member and replace blanket pytest.raises(Exception) with pytest.raises(BackendHTTPError) asserting .code == 429

The unknown-backend test must exercise select_backend with both a known key and an unknown key to prove it raises BackendRegistryError on miss, not merely pin that BackendRegistryError is not a KeyError
